html:
Kingston was founded in 1692 on the north shore of its harbour by people fleeing the earthquake that destroyed Port Royal. It became the capital of Jamaica in 1872, replacing Spanish Town.

Its deep natural harbour made it the island's main port for sugar, rum and later bananas and bauxite. An earthquake and fire in 1907 destroyed much of the city.

In the 20th century poor rural migrants crowded into West Kingston, in districts like Trench Town. There, in the 1950s to 1970s, musicians created ska, rocksteady and reggae, with stars such as Bob Marley. The same districts saw the political gang violence that has troubled the city since the 1970s.
